definitions: A male given name of Arabic origin.
Salman of Persia, also known as Salman al-Farsi, a companion of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.
Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, the current King of Saudi Arabia.
examples: Salman is a common name in many Muslim-majority countries.
The story of Salman al-Farsi is inspiring.
King Salman ascended to the throne in 2015.
